title: A principal ideal domain is a Noetherian normal domain
statement: Let $A$ be a principal ideal domain: an integral domain in which every ideal is generated by one element. Then $A$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $A$ is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]: every element of the fraction field of $A$ which is a root of a monic polynomial with coefficients in $A$ lies in $A$.
